query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',u.id,'username',u.username,'disabled_at',u.disabled_at,'deleted_at',u.deleted_at,'is_admin',u.is_admin,'must_change_password',u.must_change_password,'mfa',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'label',label,'enabled_at',enabled_at)),'[]') FROM user_mfa WHERE user_id=u.id),'groups',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(group_id),'[]') FROM user_groups WHERE user_id=u.id),'sessions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'last_seen_at',last_seen_at,'expires_at',expires_at,'admin',admin,'ua_class',ua_class)),'[]') FROM sessions WHERE user_id=u.id)) ORDER BY u.username),'[]') AS "page!" FROM users u
